LIGACOES.CONTATO_DO_CAMPO: On the contact saved in a field

OUTRO_REGISTRO.SEM_CAMPO: No card field of the Contact type here. Create one in Settings > Custom Attributes (on the card, type Contact) so your team picks the contact from a list.
OUTRO_REGISTRO.AVISO_DO_CAMPO: If this field is filled in from what the customer writes (by AI, for example), the customer could point to another contact in the account. Prefer a field only your team fills in.
OUTRO_REGISTRO.SITUACAO: Which cards? With none marked, any card counts.

EXPLICACAO.CONTATO_DO_CAMPO: The steps inside run on the contact whose number is in that field. The automation goes on without waiting for them.
EXPLICACAO.CARDS_DO_CONTATO: The steps inside run on each matching card, one at a time. The current card is left out. Messages go to the current conversation.

FRASE.CONVERSA: In the conversation of whoever is in {campo}
FRASE.CARDS: On each other card of this contact
FRASE.CARD_MAIS_RECENTE: On this contact's most recent card
FRASE.SEM_LIGACAO: On another contact or card: choose where
